How to get your schedule in

From the Aeries Student Portal
1 Log in to your Aeries Portal
2 From the left side menu, select "Classes"
3 Save your Classes page as a PDF, or just take a screenshot
Screenshot (often easiest): zoom out if needed so the whole class table fits on screen, then take a regular screenshot.
PDF instead: on a computer, press Ctrl+P (Windows) or Cmd+P (Mac) and choose "Save as PDF." On a phone, use "Quick Print" and save/share as a PDF.
4 Back in CDM Class Finder, click "Upload my schedule PDF or screenshot"
5 Load the PDF or screenshot you saved into the upload box
Note: If you don't have your class schedule as a PDF or screenshot, you can use the "Enter my classes manually" option instead.
